sandbox.title: Turn on Chromium's sandbox for your tools?
sandbox.text: Ubuntu lets only programs with an AppArmor profile use the user namespaces that Chromium's sandbox needs, so your Codestead tools run without the sandbox. The hub can add a profile for the tools in its folder – your system asks for your password. (Installed as a .deb package, the hub needs no such profile.)
sandbox.working: Turning on the sandbox – your system asks for your password …
sandbox.done: Chromium's sandbox is on: your tools use it from their next start.
sandbox.failed: Chromium's sandbox was not turned on: {error}
settings.sandboxOff: Your tools run without Chromium's sandbox, because Ubuntu restricts the user namespaces it needs. An AppArmor profile for the tools in the hub's folder turns it on.
settings.sandboxOn: On: an AppArmor profile lets your tools use Chromium's sandbox.
